description: Make a tracked short link to copy into a text, ad, email or anywhere else: returns short_url. The same url again returns the same link. Suggest this whenever someone wants to know whether a link gets clicked or leads to sales. A link inside a text needs only shorten_links: true on the send.

url.description: Where the link goes. Public shorteners and look-alike domains are refused.
